description: A hermetic ceramic-and-lead shell fitted over the core. Nothing gets in: not fallout, not fire, not the slow rot of the waste. Chrome doesn't mutate, and neither, now, do you.

failure_messages.burnout: A seal lets go with a sound like a dropped plate, somewhere under your sternum.
failure_messages.dead: The chassis is a dead weight around your core. Nothing is sealed. Nothing is cooled.
failure_messages.fault: Thermal alarms scream somewhere inside your chest as the cooling loop gives out.
failure_messages.strain: The chassis is holding heat it was built to shed. Your whole core feels like a closed room in summer.

name: Rad-sealed Chassis
